events.description: A read-only worktree listing was invoked outside a Git repository.
events.recovery: Resolve the exact Vesper source worktree before any further Git probe.

events.description: A PowerShell-expanded wildcard was passed where the text searcher required literal file paths.
events.recovery: Enumerate exact files or search a literal directory without a shell wildcard.

events.description: A broad activation text search exceeded the bounded display budget.
events.recovery: Use exact patterns and bounded numbered windows.

events.description: The initial large activation-packet window truncated before EOF.
events.recovery: Reread consecutive forty-line windows through the measured final line.

events.description: The first complete skill-creator display exceeded model context.
events.recovery: Reread the instruction file in two bounded numbered windows through EOF.

events.description: A broad receipt-oriented packet search expanded repetitive card prose and truncated.
events.recovery: Use the packet's terminal anchors and exact source-task final pointer.

events.description: A source-task read with tool outputs expanded historical content beyond the display bound.
events.recovery: Use a newest-turn read without tool outputs.

events.description: The bounded newest-turn source-task reread still exceeded the display bound.
events.recovery: Retain the truncation and extract only the exact terminal receipt pointer exposed in the final segment.

events.description: A bounded search across conventional receipt banks found no matching Vesper receipt.
events.recovery: Follow the exact terminal source pointer to the D-isolated phase-scratch receipt.

events.description: The first receipt projection guessed field names that were absent and returned nulls.
events.recovery: Inspect root keys, then project the observed exact fields.

events.description: A per-entry Git-show manifest verifier exceeded its time bound and outlived the wrapper.
events.recovery: Stop the exact read-only process, verify clean state, and replace repeated subprocesses.

events.description: A full-tree map recovery was too broad and exceeded its time bound.
events.recovery: Stop the exact read-only process and address only declared manifest paths.

events.description: An eager cat-file batch writer deadlocked against its unread output pipe.
events.recovery: Interleave one expression write with one framed blob read.

events.description: The first branch-existence probe used an invalid parenthesized PowerShell native-command expression.
events.recovery: Run the native command first, capture LASTEXITCODE, then construct the scalar result.

events.description: Worktree registration exceeded the direct display bound while its single Git process continued.
events.recovery: Do not repeat; inspect the exact process and wait until the branch and target path appear.

events.description: Sparse checkout exceeded the direct display bound while its exact index lock remained active.
events.recovery: Do not repeat or kill; inspect the exact lock and process until checkout completes.

events.description: A recursive diagnostic lock-file listing produced no attributable bounded result.
events.recovery: Inspect only the exact new worktree Git directory and index lock.

events.description: One exact-bound Wait-Process wrapper returned before its final scalar projection.
events.recovery: Use a separate immediate scalar state probe without repeating the underlying mutation.

events.description: A coordinated four-file title-refinement patch failed verification before writing any hunk.
events.recovery: Apply one verified file patch at a time and retain the rejected zero-write attempt.

events.description: A predecessor toolchain projection guessed a nonexistent tools array and returned null fields.
events.recovery: Inspect the observed root keys and project verification_targets, python_distributions, and command_versions.

events.description: The first title-corpus digest probe had mismatched Python collection parentheses.
events.recovery: Use an explicit two-row collection and rerun only the digest projection.

events.failure: The x1 push display wrapper ended before the still-running exact push process returned output.
events.recovery: Waited on the exact process, observed its exit, and did not replay the push.

events.failure: A combined x1 equality projection exceeded the model display budget.
events.recovery: Recovered with two bounded scalar probes for local equality and fresh-live divergence.

events.failure: PowerShell rejected a Bash-style here-string redirection in the sparse-pattern update.
events.recovery: Used a materialized PowerShell string piped to the supported stdin form.

events.failure: A guessed bundled Python executable path did not exist.
events.recovery: Resolved the installed Python executable with a read-only command lookup.

events.failure: A first command-lookup projection used an invalid empty PowerShell pipe element.
events.recovery: Materialized the foreach results before piping them to JSON.

events.failure: A generated patch script contained an unescaped template delimiter and failed before mutation.
events.recovery: Replaced the delimiter with plain quoted documentation text.

events.failure: A patch attempted delete-and-add operations against the same skill file in one patch and was rejected before mutation.
events.recovery: Used one exact update operation per initialized skill file.

events.failure: The first x2 build rejected a private absolute executable path in its own toolchain evidence.
events.recovery: Reduced command evidence to bounded executable basenames and reran only the owner-local builder.

events.failure: The first scoped x2 test invocation failed two dependency checks: serialized channel-key order was treated as semantic, and a coarse JSON-count floor exceeded the exact generated set.
events.recovery: Made channel vocabulary validation order-independent, aligned the bounded JSON floor to the exact artifact scale, and reran only the failed tests before the final scoped composite.

events.failure: The exact x2 staging wrapper exceeded its display window while the single Git add process continued with an index lock.
events.recovery: Observed the exact processes and lock, waited without replay, then confirmed 332 staged paths before continuing with the deferred review.

events.failure: The first per-entry x2 staged review exceeded its display window and remained active; a recovery probe launched a duplicate read-only review before the original process became visible.
events.recovery: Allowed both noncanonical read-only reviews to finish, retained the duplicate at zero credit, and replaced per-entry Git process spawning with one interleaved cat-file batch for subsequent review.

events.failure: The exact x2 cached-diff hygiene gate rejected one trailing blank line in each of ten thin runner entrypoints.
events.recovery: Removed only the ten extra EOF blank lines, retained the failed gate at zero credit, and regenerated every dependent ledger and manifest.

failure_retention_rule: Every failure remains explicit at zero completion or canonical credit; recovery never erases a failure.
